newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks recoup some losses in quieter week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks recoup some losses in quieter week.

text.p: Bahrain stocks recouped some lost ground in the week to Thursday, with the index moving up 8.32 points after a 14.76 point fall the previous week, official figures show.
The Bahrain Stock Exchange said the index rose to 1,539.59 points from 1,531.27 points a week earlier.

With the start of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan, trading volume dropped sharply to five million shares worth 1.14 million dinars ($3.0 million) from 9.9 million shares worth 2.96 million dinars the previous week.
Shares of 22 firms of the 39 registered at the bourse were traded in 183 transactions.
Bahrain's bouse is open to nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Some firms are also open to foreign investors. ($1=0.377 dinar)
